reviews.name: Thomas Richter
reviews.comment: A wonderful place to stay before our Adam’s Peak hike. Friendly family, clean rooms, and a great location.

reviews.name: Sarah Morris
reviews.comment: Amazing hospitality and beautiful views. The room was spacious and the family was so welcoming.

reviews.name: Julien Dupont
reviews.comment: Clean, comfortable and peaceful. Great Sri Lankan dinner cooked fresh on site.
